originalSourceText:
Q.10  Two users say exactly the same sentence: “I finished the assignment.”
      User A previously told the robot they were struggling with the assignment. User B
       previously said they found it very easy.
      According  to  the memory-based  dialogue  architecture, why  could  the  robot
       appropriately respond differently?

      (A) The memory-augmented context differs between users, even though the immediate
       input sentence is the same

      (B) ASR produces different words for the two users

      (C) TTS automatically changes the semantic meaning

      (D) The robot's emotion state is independent of conversation context

       Explanation: The stored context and estimated emotions are jointly used to plan an
       appropriate response.
      Refer slide 23 of Lecture 50: Developing An Emotion Engine For Robots
